search.query: Old School RuneScape update economy Jagex
search.snippet: Jagex, the studio behind Old School RuneScape, has cracked down on market manipulation in their game's economy. This move comes after an investigation into cryptocurrency-fueled market manipulation revealed attempts to use in-game items for real-world gain.
search.title: Jagex Cracks Down on Crypto-Driven Market Manipulation in Old School ...

search.query: Old School RuneScape update economy Jagex
search.snippet: It's a fairly direct line in the sand from Jagex, especially for Old School RuneScape, where item values and player-driven trading are a huge part of the game. The message is simple enough: if real money is being tied to the price of in-game items, Jagex doesn't want it in the economy. Further reading: Official Old School RuneScape news
search.title: Jagex Bans Crypto and Meme Coin Schemes Tied to OSRS Item Prices

intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and range-bound; participants are prioritizing cost of entry and fill probability over aggressive reversion, producing low-volatility, low-alpha conditions.
